title: Buffett Started Buying THIS Stock… Now Berkshire Is Going ALL IN
speaker: Ross Givens

macro_themes.view: Bond yields at the highest since 2002 crush homebuilder margins via mortgage buydowns.
Expects the Fed to be forced to cut, maybe not October but definitely in 2027; rates fall as soon as markets anticipate it, lifting homebuilders first.

calls.reason: Berkshire built a ~10% stake at 75-82; trades ~0.9x book with low debt, buybacks and a 2.5% dividend; margins recover once rates fall, as in 2022 when the stock doubled the next year.
calls.quote: this is one of the very few real value stocks in the market today.

notes: Ticker spoken as 'LM' and name 'LAR/Lenar' = Lennar (LEN). Admits the stock is in a downtrend; this is a value/long-horizon buy, not a breakout. No date stated; listing Oct 3.
